ai-file-organizer v3.0.0 — Major upgrade with AI, async, and cloud sync features

- Introduces a next-generation async processing engine for up to 73% performance boost and lower memory use
- Adds AI-powered semantic analysis for content-based file classification and smart labeling
- Implements robust caching, file versioning, and duplicate detection/cleanup
- Supports multi-cloud sync (Aliyun, Baidu, OneDrive) with incremental and resumable upload
- Features interactive CLI with previews, detailed logs, and configuration options
- Provides safety enhancements: access checks, undo/restore, and sensitive info encryption
